title.narrative: Early lifesaving response to communities projected to be most affected by El Nino induced riverine flooding in Dollow

description.narrative: ltpgtThere is now a greater than 90 per cent chance that El Nino will continue through the end of the year and will affect 1.2 million people in areas at high risk of flooding. This year’s riverine floods are considered of very high magnitude (1 in 100 years return period) and will be exacerbated by the above normal rainfall in Somalia, Ethiopia and Kenya. Somalia being a downstream country will receive the floodwaters from upstream countries plus the rainfall falling within the Somalia territory. The scale of the El Nino related riverine flooding could lead to loss of life, mass displacement, destruction of infrastructure and livelihoods, and increased incidence of communicable diseases. This could result in an increase in the magnitude and severity of acute food insecurity, and a spike in acute watery diarrhea and cholera outbreak.lt/pgtltpgt lt/pgtltpgtIn order to help ltspan style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34) font-family: Roboto, sans-serif text-align: left background-color: rgb(252, 253, 253) text-decoration-color: initial display: inline !important"gtVulnerable displacement and disasters affected populations have access to transitional or durable shelter, including local and environmentally friendly solutions, enabling safer and more dignified living standards and preventing recovering communities from slipping back into humanitarian need lt/spangtJuba Foundation will procure Standard Shelter cluster recommended NFIs kits and Plastic sheets to 3000 HHs (beneficiaries) who will be displaced by the expected El Nino floods in Dollow district, the planned NFIs kits for each HH will be comprised of 3 Blankets, 2 Sleeping Mats, 1 Kitchen Set, 1 Mosquito Net, 1 Solar Torch and 2 Jerry cans with a capacity of 10 liters. In addition to that Juba Foundation will also procure 7576 pieces of Plastic sheets which will be distributed to the same beneficiaries who receive NFI Kits, each HH will receive 2 plastic sheets lt/pgtltpgtJuba Foundation will mainstream protection, all Juba Foundation staff who will be involved in this project and our sub-contractors will sign JF code of Con duct and shall be trained on PSEA and ensure inclusion of minority groups, marginalized clans, women and people living with disability through engaging with target communities and other stakeholders including community committees, local authority, community leaders, elders women and youth groups by community based participatory approach in community sensitization meetings. To reduce the risk of Aid Diversion Juba Foundation will closely work with target communities and local authorities to put transparency measures and encourage everyone including beneficiaries to reject aid selling and buying and during selection only families who need NFI kits and Plastic sheets will be eligible to receive.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtJuba Foundation will also work closely with other partners implementing complementing activities in Dollow like Gedo Women Development Organization (GEWDO) who will implement Food Security, TROCAIRE who will implement health activities, Nomadic Assistance for Peace andltbrgtDevelopment (NAPAD) who will implement WASH activities and SEDHURO who will implement Integrated GBV Child Protection for coordination and information sharing. Juba foundation will attend regional and national shelter cluster meetings.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtJuba Foundation will coordinate and work with all stakeholders including OCHA, (SHF), government of Somalia, Jubaland State, Dollow local authorities and target communities.lt/pgt
